mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sender_id = #{memberId} THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalSendAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN receiver_id = #{memberId} THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReceiveAmount FROM settlements WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND (sender_id = #{memberId} OR receiver_id = #{memberId})

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.name AS receiverName, s.amount AS amount, m.bank_name AS bankName, m.account_number AS accountNumber, s.is_done AS isDone FROM settlements s JOIN members m ON s.receiver_id = m.member_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND s.sender_id = #{memberId}

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.sender_id AS senderId, m.name AS senderName, s.amount AS amount, s.is_done AS isDone FROM settlements s JOIN members m ON s.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND s.receiver_id = #{memberId}
